race.comment: REGAL PROBLEM (6) has been in work for a while but her form is standing up. Stepped up to Saturday company and was knocked off in a photo by CHIX over 1300m at Randwick last start. Joe Pride pops the blinkers on his mare today which should help maintain her performance level. Big chance again. Promising mare CHIX (1) made it two from two this prep, and five of eight overall, when she edged out REGAL PROBLEM last time out. Open to further improvement at just the third run of the prep. Expect there won't be much between them again. MISS SPACEGIRL (2) was five weeks between runs when beaten just under three lengths by CHIX last time. Fitter and can close that gap. ERTIJAAJ (3) is a chance from gate one with the claim.
